text.zh-Hans: 应用底色。浅色模式几乎是白色但不是纯白，深色模式几乎是黑色但不是纯黑。
text.en-US: App background. Light mode: almost white, never pure white. Dark mode: almost black, never pure black.

text.zh-Hans: 侧栏和条纹区域，比第 1 阶偏一点，用来划分区域。
text.en-US: Sidebar and striped areas; slightly offset from step 1 to separate regions.

text.zh-Hans: 组件的默认底色，也是悬停时的底色。
text.en-US: Default component background, also used as the hover background.

text.zh-Hans: 组件的悬停底色，比第 3 阶再偏一档。
text.en-US: Component hover background, one notch further from step 3.

text.zh-Hans: 组件按下或选中的底色。
控件边框和焦点环，比分割线明显。
text.en-US: Control borders and focus rings; more visible than dividers.

text.zh-Hans: 色阶里最“实”的一阶，做实色背景。两个主题都把它用作三级文字（提示文字），此处对比度偏低。
text.en-US: The most solid step of the scale, used for solid backgrounds. It doubles as tertiary text (hint text), where its contrast is low.

text.zh-Hans: 实色背景悬停时的颜色。
text.en-US: Color of a solid background on hover.

text.zh-Hans: 低对比文字（二级文字），压在第 2 阶底上仍保证可读。
text.en-US: Low-contrast (secondary) text; stays readable on a step 2 background.

text.zh-Hans: 高对比文字：标题、正文、图标。
text.en-US: High-contrast text: headings, body text, icons.

rationale.zh-Hans: 窗口最底层，取第 1 阶（浅色里最浅，深色里最深）。浅色不用纯白，把白留给“浮起来”的卡片；深色不用纯黑，避免和屏幕边缘糊成一片。
rationale.en-US: Lowest window layer, step 1 (the lightest in light mode, the darkest in dark mode). Light mode avoids pure white so white can be kept for raised cards; dark mode avoids pure black so the window does not blur into the screen edge.

rationale.zh-Hans: 只比窗口底偏一点点：浅色略深，深色略亮，侧栏就成为独立区域，不需要再画边框。
rationale.en-US: Only slightly different from the window background — a touch darker in light mode, a touch lighter in dark mode, so the sidebar reads as its own region without needing a border.

rationale.zh-Hans: 卡片和输入框要比窗口底更靠近光源：浅色用纯白，深色取第 3 阶。两种模式下它都比窗口底更亮，方向一致，层级不靠阴影。
rationale.en-US: Cards and inputs sit closer to the light than the window background: pure white in light mode, step 3 in dark mode. In both modes the surface is brighter than the window background, so hierarchy does not rely on shadows.

rationale.zh-Hans: 悬停只比当前底色偏一档，变化小到不抢眼，又大到能被感知。深色多偏一阶，因为暗底上相邻灰更难分辨。
rationale.en-US: Hover is only one notch off the current background: small enough not to distract, large enough to notice. Dark mode shifts one step more because adjacent grays are harder to tell apart on dark backgrounds.

rationale.zh-Hans: 选中比悬停再偏一档，两种状态一眼能分开。
rationale.en-US: Selected is one more notch beyond hover, so the two states are distinguishable at a glance.

rationale.zh-Hans: 分割线要看得见但不抢内容。Radix 把第 6 阶定为细边框；浅色用 5，深色用 6 是我们的判断：暗底上线条要多一档才看得清。
rationale.en-US: Dividers should be visible without competing with content. Radix defines step 6 as the subtle border; using 5 in light mode and 6 in dark mode is our own judgment: lines need one more notch to be seen on dark backgrounds.

rationale.zh-Hans: 输入框边框和焦点环。Radix 把第 7 阶定为控件边框和焦点环，比分割线明显，用来告诉用户“这里可以输入”。
rationale.en-US: Input border and focus ring. Radix defines step 7 as the control border and focus ring; it is more visible than a divider and tells users "you can type here".

rationale.zh-Hans: 标题和正文。Radix 保证第 12 阶压在第 2 阶底上对比度足够。用第 12 阶的值，而不是纯黑纯白，减少长时间阅读的刺眼和发光。
rationale.en-US: Headings and body text. Radix designs step 12 to have sufficient contrast on a step 2 background. Using the step 12 value instead of pure black or white reduces glare and halation during long reading.

rationale.zh-Hans: 说明文字。第 11 阶是 Radix 的低对比文字，仍满足 4.5:1，可承载信息。
rationale.en-US: Supporting text. Step 11 is Radix's low-contrast text, which still meets 4.5:1 and can carry information.

rationale.zh-Hans: 时间戳、占位符。第 9 阶对比度低于 4.5:1，所以只能用在“少了也不影响理解”的位置。这是已知限制，不是疏忽。
rationale.en-US: Timestamps and placeholders. Step 9 contrast is below 4.5:1, so it may only be used where losing it does not hurt understanding. This is a known limitation, not an oversight.

rationale.zh-Hans: 表示“可以点”：主按钮、选中项。选蓝色是因为它与状态色里的红、绿、琥珀都不冲突。浅色取能与白字达到 4.5:1 的蓝，深色取更亮的蓝并配深色字，同样需达到 4.5:1。待对照参考应用校准。
rationale.en-US: Signals "can be clicked": primary buttons, selected items. Blue was chosen because it does not clash with the red, green and amber status colors. Light mode uses a blue that reaches 4.5:1 with white text; dark mode uses a lighter blue with dark text, which must also reach 4.5:1. Pending calibration against a reference application.

rationale.zh-Hans: 运行中。与强调色同色相，但只用在小标签上，不做大面积填充，避免和主按钮混淆。
rationale.en-US: Running. Same hue as the accent, but only used on small labels and never as a large fill, to avoid confusion with the primary button.

rationale.zh-Hans: 成功。浅色取深一档的绿，保证文字对比度；深色取亮绿。永远配对勾图标和文字，不单靠颜色。
rationale.en-US: Success. Light mode uses a darker green to keep text contrast; dark mode uses a bright green. Always paired with a check icon and text, never color alone.

rationale.zh-Hans: 需要确认。黄色在浅底上很难达到对比度，所以浅色的琥珀必须取得更暗才能达到对比度；深色取更亮的琥珀。配三角图标。
rationale.en-US: Needs confirmation. Yellow struggles to reach contrast on light backgrounds, so the amber must be darker in light mode to reach the contrast and lighter in dark mode. Paired with a triangle icon.

rationale.zh-Hans: 失败。浅色取偏深的红，深色取偏粉的亮红，避免暗底上红色发闷。配叉号图标。
rationale.en-US: Failure. Light mode uses a deeper red; dark mode uses a pinkish bright red so the red does not look dull on dark backgrounds. Paired with a cross icon.
